snippet.title: ZERO MASS — Mine. Upgrade. Explore. | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Turn an asteroid into a payday. Bring your ship home in one piece.

ZERO MASS is a third-person space mining game where you carve through asteroids, collect valuable resources and build a ship suited to your next job.

Choose your tools, manage your cargo and upgrade your equipment between shifts. Take on mining contracts, investigate strange discoveries and face unexpected encounters—from debris storms and electrical hazards to wreck recovery and alien attacks.

Every haul brings new possibilities. How far will you push your next shift?

🚀 Find ZERO MASS on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5504190/
